name: Christmas Village
description: An animated pixel art screensaver of a snowy Christmas village that follows the time of day: daylight and drifting clouds by day, a glowing sunset, then moonlight, twinkling stars and Santa's sleigh at night. Snow falls, the tree lights twinkle, the chimneys smoke and the river shimmers. Select Christmas Village under Screensaver > Screensaver mode.
author: MozKaboom

settings.title: Time of day
settings.description: Follow the kiosk's clock, keep it day or night, or run through a whole day every three minutes to see it all.

settings.title: Sunrise
settings.description: When it gets light. The sky brightens from about 50 minutes before.

settings.title: Sunset
settings.description: When it gets dark. The sunset glow starts about 50 minutes before.

settings.title: Snow
settings.description: How much snow falls. A blizzard blows sideways.

settings.title: Santa at night
settings.description: Santa's sleigh flies across the sky every minute or two at night.
